summary: An OpenAI researcher tweets a personal narrative of AI math progress from 2023 to 2025 and claims GPT-5.6 now solves unspecified 'famous frontier math/stat questions', framing an IMO gold-medal performance as no longer newsworthy.

practices.reason: The claim that GPT-5.6 solves frontier math/stat problems is asserted without any benchmark name, score, or link, so it gives nothing concrete to act on.
practices.quote: Now, GPT-5.6 solves famous frontier math/stat questions.
